body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 20:19Z; I repeated the 2026-10-12 miss). EVERY instruction that asks a worker to request an acceptance evaluation must restate, verbatim: "after termal_evaluate_acceptance: no tracker write, no mail; hold the turn OPEN with termal_wait_delegations on the evaluator delegation until it submits; only then read the verdict, mail and note."

On 10-20 I told Sol-c593 to "request termal_evaluate_acceptance now… mail me the evaluation id". Both w-9ca5 evaluators intended PASS but were refused 409 "source root changed" (w-539ea7e8b506 / w-eda892234c41), wasting two Opus evaluations and about 15 min. Source: memory live-workaround-eval-submission.
